tasks.title: Write Dockerfile to containerize the React/Vite app
tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile at the project root (/Users/one-don/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/Dockerfile) using a multi-stage build. Stage 1 (builder): use node:20-alpine, set WORKDIR /app, copy package.json and package-lock.json (if present), run 'npm ci', copy the rest of the source, then run 'npm run build' (which executes 'tsc && vite build' per package.json, outputting to dist/). Stage 2 (runtime): use nginx:alpine, copy the built dist/ folder from the builder stage to /usr/share/nginx/html, expose port 80, and set CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]. The dev server runs on port 5173 (vite.config.ts) but the production container should serve the static build via nginx on port 80. Do NOT modify any existing source files.
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile exists at the project root
Multi-stage build: node:20-alpine builder stage installs deps and runs npm run build
Runtime stage uses nginx:alpine to serve the dist/ output
CMD starts nginx in foreground mode
